question: Does the 5 kb -> 10 kb flank behave the same outside Enterobacterales?
dataset: 323 actinomycete genomes, screen on in both arms, same code.

clustering.detail: two Glycomyces clusters merge at 10 kb (G. paridis CPCC 204357 and Glycomyces sp. NRRL B-16210); two S. griseus clusters split (NPDC020758, NPDC042341).

reading: This is where the actinomycete set earned its place. On P. ananatis the flank change left GCF membership identical (ARI 1.0000); here it does not (ARI 0.9524). Four of 32 BGCs change assignment. The claim "widening the flank does not move GCF structure" was a single-clade result and does not generalise. The shift is small and arguably an improvement - more of the cluster, less of an arbitrary boundary - but it is a change in the output, not a no-op, and downstream family-level numbers move with it.
